7-9. Show that the formula

\[ A \cdot \left\lbrack x\right\rbrack = \left\lbrack {Ax}\right\rbrack \]

defines a smooth, transitive left action of $\mathrm{{GL}}\left( {n + 1,\mathbb {R}}\right)$ on ${\mathbb {{RP}}}^{n}$ . \end{exercise}
